title: Bibliographic sources of the data catalogue
policy: Every catalogue value cites one of these sources. A source records what was consulted (edition, version or access date) and the licence or usage terms as far as known; 'unknown' is stated explicitly rather than assumed. Model equations and numerical methods cite their original or textbook source (v6.1).
